ImageDescription.value:
At Abundance360, we explored various worlds in an immersive VR experience. This was my first experience in a dyad, and the interaction was fantastic. When we were exploring a dungeon together and came across some spiders, she naturally handed me the torch to do my man chore and burn and stomp them out. It seemed so natural.

And after a full 20 minutes, we wanted more (a first for a VR experience for either of us). Perhaps it came from the millimeter tracking precision off of the reflector balls.

Dreamscape just came out of stealth.

Credit.value: Dreamscape Immersive Social VR

ImageDescription.value:
On 9 May, the European Union celebrates its achievements of unity and long-term peace, commemorating the signing of the Schuman Declaration in 1950.

On April and May 2024, with the European Elections around the corner (6-9 June 2024), the European Parliament invited visitors to join engaging events all around Europe, one of them being the open doors in the European Parliament seat in Strasbourg (Saturday 27 April)

__

For more information on the European elections and on how to vote, visit: elections.europa.eu/en/

__

If you would like to receive reminders on when you should vote, please visit the together.eu website: together.europarl.europa.eu/

ImageDescription.value: On the occasion of the Scientific and Environmental Exploration Film Festival, Lumexplore (September 2019, La Ciotat), Ifremer hosted an interactive workshop under a marquee with a virtual reality device that showcases the optical mapping work in the underwater environment carried out by engineers from the "Underwater Systems" Unit at the Ifremer Mediterranean Center in La Seyne. Thanks to the geo-referenced images of Ifremer's underwater vehicles, the 3D reconstruction generated by software, and modern virtual reality headset technologies, visitors had the sensation of being on an exploration dive, above a hydrothermal chimney in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

Credit.value: Festival Lumexplore : animation Ifremer 3D
